scope: source-only conditional-identifiability construction and synthetic probe; no real target outcomes

gate.interpretation: Descriptive Monte Carlo-scale screen; not source admissibility, sampling uncertainty, clinical confidence, statistical equivalence, or an equivalence-test margin.

independent_analytic_certificate.materiality_rule: MAX absolute gap >=5 mg/dL over all four predeclared cells; not EACH cell
independent_analytic_certificate.proof: Softplus is increasing, male BMI slope positive and age slope negative, so opposite enclosing rectangle corners bound the conditional mean. Log lognormal density is concave in (log y, log mean): a linear term minus a squared affine term. Its minimum on each rectangular band occurs at a vertex. The eight evaluated vertices certify f0>=d_min. Since |hA*hB|<=1 and |hT|<=1/50, delta=.8*50*d_min gives f_t>=.2*f0. The kernel integrates to zero at every covariate point. Exact marginal centering plus the declared product covariate law cancels the density perturbation from both bivariate outcome laws.
independent_analytic_certificate.numeric_tolerance: Independent certificate number comparisons use rel_tol=2e-13, abs_tol=2e-15 for separately evaluated elementary functions only; source paired gates retain zero added tolerance.

fixed_source_context_departure.interpretation: Descriptive fixed synthetic context departure from its empirical-marginal product; full-grid TV reflects finite sparsity. No independence test, source-population inference, or clinical CI.

oh_table2_boundary_note: Calculation uses lower-inclusive upper-exclusive BMI bins [20,23), [23,25), [25,30), [30,infinity); the paper's final display label >30 remains visible. Discrete reconstruction boundary assignment is an approximation.

unassessed_source_estimands.estimand: BMI coefficient with additional metabolic adjustment
unassessed_source_estimands.reason: Required metabolic covariates and analysis specification are unavailable; cannot substitute age/sex/BMI OLS.

unassessed_source_estimands.estimand: BMI coefficient in mixed/family lifestyle model
unassessed_source_estimands.reason: Required adjustment covariates, family structure, and mixed-model estimand are unavailable.
Twin pairing and within-pair design cannot be recovered from this synthetic context.

source_text_anomaly: Oh Table2 FBS-stratum entries labelled TG reconstruct fasting-glucose rather than TG means; not interpreted as resolved TG constraints.
limitations: Source covariate independence, marginal shapes/support, assay mapping, and missing family/covariate structure are assumptions.
Passing preserves the chosen anchor's discrepancies and does not establish source admissibility or compatibility with all paper evidence.
Historical and new generator-seed spread describe simulation variation, not paper uncertainty or confidence intervals.
The known analytic separation threshold is a design criterion; there is no clinical interpretation.
Three additional Oh estimands remain unassessed; neither model is declared compatible with them.
boundary_disclosure: Agent inventory automatically displayed unrelated completed-agent summaries while locating the source designer. They were not used in M6; no associated artifacts, participant rows, historical target data, or target reports were opened.

endpoint_definitions.scaling: A=(age-50)/10; B=(BMI-25)/5; F=1(sex=2); all models have an intercept and unweighted OLS
endpoint_definitions.main: log(TG)~1+A+B+F: report age, BMI and female coefficients

probe.interpretation: The common equally weighted synthetic grid is a model illustration; ten replicates per cell and three generator seeds are not human truth or clinical uncertainty. Grid projections depend on this prespecified covariate weighting.
